caption: 📓 Lesson of the day: Journaling. A trading journal is a simple record of every trade and the reason behind it. Write down your entry, stop loss, target, risk, and how you felt before you clicked. Add the result later, and note whether you followed your plan. Example only: if 3 of your last 5 losses came from entering late, your journal shows a habit you can work on. Review your notes each weekend and pick one thing to improve next week. Educational content, not financial advice. Trading is high risk.
